test_name: Navigation Between Tabs (Test Plans, Analysis, Generations)
description: This scenario tests the navigation between the Test Plans, Analysis, and Generations tabs to ensure seamless transitions and proper page rendering.
steps: 1. Start on the Test Plans page at https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/tests.
2. Verify the 'Test Plans' tab is active.
4. Verify that the URL changes to https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/analyses.
5. Verify that the Analysis page content is rendered properly.
7. Verify that the URL changes to https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/events.
8. Verify that the Generations page content is rendered properly.
9. Click back to the 'Test Plans' tab.
10. Verify that the URL changes back to https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/tests.
11. Reload the Test Plans page and verify the active tab persists.
12. Use keyboard navigation (Tab/Shift+Tab) to navigate between the tabs.
13. Verify focus indicators are visible on each tab during keyboard navigation.
14. Resize the browser window to test responsiveness of the tabs.
15. Test navigation on a mobile device emulator.
16. Click on the tabs multiple times in quick succession and verify no errors occur.
17. Verify that browser back/forward buttons correctly navigate between the tabs.
expected_results: The active tab is visually highlighted.
Page content updates correctly without errors.
The URL updates to match the selected tab.
Navigation is responsive across different viewport sizes.
Keyboard navigation successfully cycles through the tabs.
edge_cases: Clicking on tabs while the page is still loading.
Navigating back from a tab that no longer exists.
Testing on a very low-resolution screen.
Pressing the browser's back button during tab navigation.
data_requirements: Valid tab elements with unique data-testid attributes.
Pre-rendered content for Analysis and Generations pages.
dependencies: All tabs must be functional and accessible.
The backend must support content rendering for Analysis and Generations pages.
No network downtime during the test.
performance_metrics: Tabs should remain responsive even under high load.
accessibility_requirements: WCAG 2.1: Provide focus indicators on each tab.
Ensure ARIA roles are used for tab navigation.
Test screen reader compatibility for tab navigation.
